## About BloodPril

BloodPril is a premium blood pressure support dietary supplement containing
8 clinically researched ingredients: Berberine HCl 500 mg, Hibiscus Flower
Extract 400 mg, Olive Leaf Extract (Oleuropein 20%) 400 mg, Hawthorn Berry
Extract 300 mg, Coenzyme Q10 100 mg, Garlic Extract (1% Allicin) 400 mg,
Magnesium Glycinate 200 mg, and Potassium Gluconate 99 mg.

Manufactured in an FDA-registered, GMP-certified facility in the United States.

**Disclaimer:** These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA.
BloodPril is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Always consult a physician before starting any supplement.
